items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring mandatory base components are verified before parallel development of feature sets begins.
The blocking shared infrastructure layer containing core models, storage handlers, and dispatch logic.
The specific functional outcome a user must achieve to validate a feature set.
A unique sequential numeric identifier assigned to each persistent entry.
The standardized lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent local storage and optional command-line output.
The minimum viable product scope encompassing only the essential ability to create and mark entries as finished.
The structural grouping of atomic work units by their associated user stories.
The set of mandatory design and data-model documents required before implementation.
The primary documentation file specifying command usage and persistence behavior.
The initial phase involving directory skeleton creation and pyproject.toml configuration.
The specific implementation unit for handling zero-entry states in the listing output.
The verification process conducted via quickstart smoke tests rather than automated suites.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the created_at attribute during entry instantiation.
The operational command used to purge all finished entries from the persistent store.
The operation used to retrieve and display all stored entries in either human-readable or structured format.
A high-severity constraint marking a phase that must be fully completed before any dependent work begins.
